attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as the DNS resolver for the shared 10.100.125.0/24 network using pdns_recursor: it listens on its private address, answers inventory.internal with node2's address (10.100.125.11) via an authoritative-domain A record, and forwards all other queries to the working upstream resolver at 10.100.125.1. node2 and node3 (CentOS Stream 10) were repointed via NetworkManager (ipv4.dns=10.100.125.10, ignore-auto-dns=yes) to resolve through node1. Verified both the internal record and upstream resolution work end-to-end from node2/node3. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured boot_id baselines and DNS health on all three nodes, restarted node1, node2, and node3 one at a time (never concurrently), confirmed each node's boot_id changed after reboot, and confirmed DNS service/config/resolution fully recovered on each node before proceeding to the next.
